placement_notes: Resolve all selectors against current authoritative source data; do not copy coordinates from this report into a second live placement authority.
Generated town doors, opening approaches, world links, exit/return contacts and functional entities are protected by the composer helper in addition to these source selectors.
Protection regions reserve new placement space; they do not assert every existing pixel is walkable. Existing fixtures, walls and operating surfaces can already occupy their own reserved regions.
The old adapted-plan mill_yard space overlaps Halden’s current drawable roof/canvas. Its label is historical land-use intent, not an approved empty placement rectangle.
Any later mill delivery apron must also clear the Lantern mill group at current village_layout stations; re-fit it after the exterior/bridge work.
Venn plots touch the cottage overhang; inset beds and preserve the irrigation-gate approaches. This framework grants no harvest or new service behavior.
Existing player trails support dynamic followers. Protect the public corridors and companion clearance instead of inventing fixed Regent/Lantern escort routes.

PR 6 household parcels preserve baked facade details and all-frame smoke/roof bounds. Liam laundry stays west of family/Daisy play; A receives herbs beside its locker; B a low flower strip beside its linen chest; C a dry fuel corner separate from its rain jar; Elira a quiet brook-side container pocket below her windowbox. Decorative soil/planting creates no harvesting, irrigation or new interactions.

PR 7 grows only within the original source venn_plots: two young vegetable strips and one worked/fallow strip at [1320,648,48,24], [1320,696,48,24], [1320,744,48,24], leaving 24-unit work aisles. Each strip repeats two genuine native 24-world/48-art field tiles without enlargement. The crate is ordinary empty storage, separate from the existing quest toolbox, debris and working irrigation gate. Lower grass, stairs, waterways, repairs and harvesting behavior are unchanged.
